# Vera Staging

Vera Staging is a done-for-you virtual staging service operated by MS ECOM LLC, serving listing agents, brokerages, teams, flippers, and real-estate photographers across the United States. Empty listing photos are furnished digitally, human-reviewed, and returned within 24 hours with a full MLS disclosure pack.

## Prices

- Single photo: $29 per photo
- Listing Pack: $199 — 8 photos of one home
- Brokerage/Team Monthly: $399/month — 20 photos pooled across agents, unused photos roll over 60 days
- Photographer partners (white-label): $20 per photo wholesale, delivered under the photographer's brand

## How it works

Customer sends empty-room photos (upload or gallery link); Vera Staging adds furniture and décor only — the home itself is never altered; delivery within 24 hours includes staged + original pairs, a clean version and a version labeled "Virtually Staged", plus copy-paste disclosure caption text for MLS compliance. Unlimited revisions for 14 days. Unusable photos are refunded.
